[[Mustafar/Legends|Mustafar]] was home to a number of '''Jedi temples''' during the days of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

==History==
[[File:Mustafar_edited.jpg|thumb|left|150px]]

[[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Chu-Gon Dar]], an individual who possessed unmatched mastery of [[Physical Force]], taught students in these facilities. He created a [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] object known as the [[Chu-Gon Dar cube]] which could channel and manipulate [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] to alter the properties of a physical object placed in the artifact.

When the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] became active again, a climactic [[Devastation of Mustafar/Legends|battle]] on the planet drew a nearby [[Gas giant/Legends|gas giant]] close to the terrestrial body, starting a gravimetric assault on the planet's surface. The environment was ravaged by horrible mountains of fire, forcing the Jedi to flee off the planet, leaving behind all knowledge of Chu-Gon's cube. The ruins of the Enclave would be found again in c.[[1000 BBY/Legends|1000 BBY]], and become the base of the Force organization known as the [[Blackguard (Mustafar)/Legends|Blackguard]].

==Behind the scenes==
The Jedi Enclave appeared in the video game ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a massively multiplayer online roleplaying game developed by [[Sony]] and published by LucasArts, prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].
